# system.getAudioVoice

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.7</span></div>

Return the current audio voice.

```lua
system.getAudioVoice(voice)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `voice` |  | yes | index (number, default is 0) |

## Returns

Audio voice as a string, i.e. "en/default"

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 5 times across 5 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    voice = tostring(system.getAudioVoice() or "")
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/lib/audio.lua:26](https://github.com/robthomson/ethos-app-framework/blob/fdfd6e70f8f2865a2742102e009b791ae18e3ca9/src/rfsuite/lib/audio.lua#L26-L26)</small>

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    local audioVoice = system.getAudioVoice and system.getAudioVoice() or "AUDIO:/en/default"
    ```

    <small>[src/ofs3/lib/utils.lua:42](https://github.com/robthomson/omp-ofs3-dashboard/blob/2970572ba2b0a4b47d3789f6cd29c6acdc9b231d/src/ofs3/lib/utils.lua#L42-L42)</small>

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    local av = system.getAudioVoice():gsub("SD:", ""):gsub("RADIO:", ""):gsub("AUDIO:", ""):gsub("VOICE[1-4]:", ""):gsub("audio/", "")
    ```

    <small>[src/dashx/lib/utils.lua:247](https://github.com/robthomson/dashx-ethos/blob/6dcae492715da80d210cb4c6b16c3881c9791e2a/src/dashx/lib/utils.lua#L247-L247)</small>
